HYJ01GGT2U_C600.title: Dinner Plate
HYJ01GGT2U_C600.description: The dinner plate is unveiled as part of Cordelia de Castellane's Les Gris-Gris de Monsieur Dior collection and is embellished with the clover, Christian Dior's treasured symbol and lucky charm. Crafted in ecru ceramic elevated by delicate colors, it celebrates the art of living and the founding couturier's passion for superstition. HYJ01ABE1U_C200.title: Dinner Plate
HYJ01ABE1U_C200.description: A small, bustling beehive, that's what my house was when I presented my first collection, wrote Christian Dior in his memoir. This metaphor for the atelier at 30 Avenue Montaigne evokes the gestures of the seamstresses, conscientious and busy like a passionate and masterful swarm. Today, this majestic insect finds its place in the heart of a bucolic collection designed by Cordelia de Castellane, the Creative Director of Maison Dior, composed of earthenware plates that play with soft honey hues.
